title: Head gasket can leak coolant (warranty extended, CVT)
plain_summary: On some 2023 and newer Integras with the CVT automatic, the head gasket can stop sealing well. The engine may run hot, lose coolant or misfire. Acura lengthened the warranty on this part. An Acura dealer checks your VIN to see if it qualifies.

coverage.term: 10 years or 150,000 miles, whichever comes first

title: CVT drive belt can wear early (warranty extended)
plain_summary: The steel belt inside the CVT automatic on some 2016-2020 HR-Vs can wear out early. Cars that got the software update in bulletin 21-046 watch the belt and can set code P271E. For those cars Honda lengthened CVT coverage. A dealer checks your VIN.

coverage.term: 7 years or 150,000 miles, whichever comes first (only for cars that received the 21-046 software update)
